name: breadcrumb-bar
title: Breadcrumb bar
description: A slim bar under the header with the trail on the left and page actions on the right, folding to a single Back link on a phone.
docs: Pass the trail from the top, the last crumb being the current page, which carries aria-current and is not a link. From md up the bar shows the ordered list; once it is longer than maxItems (4) the first crumb and the last ones stay and the levels between fold into a menu with a link each. Below md it is one Back link to the nearest parent that has an href. The trail has priority on the row: its crumbs never wrap, every crumb but the current page keeps its width (a very long label is cut at 10rem with an ellipsis) and only the current page gives way when the row runs short. actions is a slot for small buttons or links such as Share, Print or Edit; updated takes the words you format, in the language and time zone of the page, and the same moment as a machine-readable dateTime; it shows from lg up, where there is room for it beside the trail and the actions. labels translates the fixed words and linkAs renders your router's Link.
